# Gates scripts/check_push_authors.py, the client-side pre-push guard: it
# refuses to push a branch carrying a commit whose author or committer email
# is not listed here. This catches a fork PR checked out onto a local branch
# and pushed to origin — client-side, before the branch ever reaches origin.

# `#` are comments. BOTS_TRUSTED_AUTHORS (comma-separated) overrides this
# file entirely when set.
